jei.neovitae.upgrade_tome.luck.info:

ritual.neovitae.butchering.desc: Slaughters adult animals in range and gathers their drops into an adjacent chest, always leaving enough of each species alive to keep breeding. Set how many of each to spare with the Ritual Configurator.
ritual.neovitae.butchering.info: Slaughters adult animals in range and gathers their drops into an adjacent chest, always leaving enough of each species alive to keep breeding. Set how many of each to spare with the Ritual Configurator.
ritual.neovitae.condor.desc: Bestows true flight upon every practitioner within the circle. Tenebrae-tier.
ritual.neovitae.condor.info: Bestows true flight upon every practitioner within the circle. Tenebrae-tier.
ritual.neovitae.containment.desc: Pushes any creature trying to leave the area back toward the center; an invisible cage.
ritual.neovitae.containment.info: Pushes any creature trying to leave the area back toward the center; an invisible cage.
ritual.neovitae.crafting.desc: Automates crafting through an adjacent inventory. Spiritus Invictus routes through a Hellfire Forge, Spiritus Ruina through a Tabula Vitae. Tenebrae-tier.
ritual.neovitae.crafting.info: Automates crafting through an adjacent inventory. Spiritus Invictus routes through a Hellfire Forge, Spiritus Ruina through a Tabula Vitae. Tenebrae-tier.
ritual.neovitae.crafting.spiritus.invict: Spiritus Invictus: Attempts a Hellfire Forge recipe first, falling back to vanilla crafting if none match.
ritual.neovitae.crafting.spiritus.ruina: Spiritus Ruina: Attempts a Tabula Vitae recipe first, falling back to vanilla crafting if none match.

ritual.neovitae.crystallum_fractura.aspe: Biases the growth aura's Spiritus injection toward the chosen aspect's crystals. Raw leaves the aura unbiased.
ritual.neovitae.crystallum_fractura.desc: Auto-harvests Spiritus Crystal clusters in range, doubles their growth speed, and biases the chunk's aspect via the Ritual Configurator.
ritual.neovitae.crystallum_fractura.info: Auto-harvests Spiritus Crystal clusters in range, doubles their growth speed, and biases the chunk's aspect via the Ritual Configurator.
ritual.neovitae.downgrade.desc: Throw a piece of Sentient Armor onto the small zone above the master stone; the ritual extracts every upgrade as a separate Upgrade Tome.
ritual.neovitae.downgrade.info: Throw a piece of Sentient Armor onto the small zone above the master stone; the ritual extracts every upgrade as a separate Upgrade Tome.
ritual.neovitae.dungeon.no_space: Not enough space: clear a %sx%sx%s area around the Master Ritual Stone.
ritual.neovitae.enchanted_vitae.conflict: The rite refuses %s alongside %s. Take one of the marked books off the stone, then offer the item again to resume.
ritual.neovitae.enchanted_vitae.desc: Throw one item and any number of enchanted books onto the master stone; the ritual reads the books and binds every enchantment the item can take, at whatever level the book carries, charging Essentia Vitae for each level. Two enchantments that cannot share an item halt the rite; remove one and offer the item again to resume. The books survive.
ritual.neovitae.enchanted_vitae.info: Throw one item and any number of enchanted books onto the master stone; the ritual reads the books and binds every enchantment the item can take, at whatever level the book carries, charging Essentia Vitae for each level. Two enchantments that cannot share an item halt the rite; remove one and offer the item again to resume. The books survive.
ritual.neovitae.enchanted_vitae.insuffic: The rite stalls: %s Essentia Vitae is needed to bind these enchantments.
ritual.neovitae.expulsion.desc: Drives every creature outward from the ritual center.
ritual.neovitae.expulsion.info: Drives every creature outward from the ritual center.
ritual.neovitae.feathered_knife.desc: Wounds the practitioner standing on the master stone, converting their health into EV for the altar.
ritual.neovitae.feathered_knife.info: Wounds the practitioner standing on the master stone, converting their health into EV for the altar.
ritual.neovitae.felling.desc: Fells every tree in range and drops the logs into an adjacent chest.
ritual.neovitae.felling.info: Fells every tree in range and drops the logs into an adjacent chest.
ritual.neovitae.forsaken_soul.desc: Watches the 21x21x21 area for non-player mob deaths and drops a charged Raw Spiritus item at each death position.
ritual.neovitae.forsaken_soul.info: Watches the 21x21x21 area for non-player mob deaths and drops a charged Raw Spiritus item at each death position.
ritual.neovitae.full_stomach.desc: Feeds every practitioner in range from food stored in an adjacent chest.
ritual.neovitae.full_stomach.info: Feeds every practitioner in range from food stored in an adjacent chest.
ritual.neovitae.green_grove.desc: Suffuses the earth with life; bonemeals nearby crops and saplings. Spiritus aspects extend it to farmland hydration, Plant Leech, or scaled chance.
ritual.neovitae.green_grove.info: Suffuses the earth with life; bonemeals nearby crops and saplings. Spiritus aspects extend it to farmland hydration, Plant Leech, or scaled chance.
ritual.neovitae.green_grove.spiritus.inv: Spiritus Invictus: Hydrates nearby farmland to full moisture.
ritual.neovitae.green_grove.spiritus.raw: Raw Spiritus: Hastens the refresh rate (20 ticks down to 10 as raw rises).
ritual.neovitae.green_grove.spiritus.rui: Spiritus Ruina: Applies Plant Leech to nearby mobs.
ritual.neovitae.green_grove.spiritus.vin: Spiritus Vindicta: Scales growth success chance up to 100%%.
ritual.neovitae.grounding.desc: Imposes heavy gravity within the area; entities that try to fly are dragged back to the earth. Spiritus aspects shift between Heavy Heart, Suspended, and Levitation effects.
ritual.neovitae.grounding.info: Imposes heavy gravity within the area; entities that try to fly are dragged back to the earth. Spiritus aspects shift between Heavy Heart, Suspended, and Levitation effects.
ritual.neovitae.harvest.desc: Reaps every mature crop in range and replants the seeds. Place a chest atop the Master Ritual Stone to collect the yield; otherwise it drops where it grew.
ritual.neovitae.harvest.info: Reaps every mature crop in range and replants the seeds. Place a chest atop the Master Ritual Stone to collect the yield; otherwise it drops where it grew.
ritual.neovitae.lava.desc: Places lava source blocks within the area.
ritual.neovitae.lava.info: Places lava source blocks within the area.
ritual.neovitae.magnetism.desc: Reaps ore blocks from the volume below the master stone (loading unloaded chunks as needed). Inserts as items into a chest at the configured chest position (directly above the master stone by default) if one is present; otherwise places the ore as a block in a 3x3x3 volume above. Scan radius scales with the foundation block: iron 7, gold 15, diamond 31, netherite 63, anything else 3. 50 EV per ore moved; up to 3 ores and 100 checks per refresh, scan reaches bedrock. Spiritus Invictus packs each emptied slot with the surrounding stone instead of leaving a hole.
ritual.neovitae.magnetism.info: Reaps ore blocks from the volume below the master stone (loading unloaded chunks as needed). Inserts as items into a chest at the configured chest position (directly above the master stone by default) if one is present; otherwise places the ore as a block in a 3x3x3 volume above. Scan radius scales with the foundation block: iron 7, gold 15, diamond 31, netherite 63, anything else 3. 50 EV per ore moved; up to 3 ores and 100 checks per refresh, scan reaches bedrock. Spiritus Invictus packs each emptied slot with the surrounding stone instead of leaving a hole.
ritual.neovitae.magnetism.spiritus.invic: Spiritus Invictus: Fills each mined slot with the surrounding stone instead of leaving it open.
ritual.neovitae.meteor.desc: Consumes a catalyst item dropped within the area and crashes a corresponding meteor from above. Catalysts are defined by meteor recipes.
ritual.neovitae.meteor.info: Consumes a catalyst item dropped within the area and crashes a corresponding meteor from above. Catalysts are defined by meteor recipes.
ritual.neovitae.phantom_bridge.desc: Weaves spectral platforms beneath the feet of practitioners in range.
ritual.neovitae.phantom_bridge.info: Weaves spectral platforms beneath the feet of practitioners in range.
ritual.neovitae.placer.desc: Places blocks drawn from an adjacent chest across the configured area. Raw Spiritus sets how large an area you may configure and how fast it fills, and the Ritual Configurator chooses the shape.
ritual.neovitae.placer.info: Places blocks drawn from an adjacent chest across the configured area. Raw Spiritus sets how large an area you may configure and how fast it fills, and the Ritual Configurator chooses the shape.
ritual.neovitae.placer.spiritus.raw: Raw Spiritus quickens the work and widens the domain: 20 raw for four blocks a pulse and 20,000 blocks of room, 50 raw for eight and 80,000.
ritual.neovitae.pump.desc: Draws fluid source blocks into a fluid tank at the configured tank position (directly above the master stone by default).
ritual.neovitae.pump.info: Draws fluid source blocks into a fluid tank at the configured tank position (directly above the master stone by default).
ritual.neovitae.regeneration.desc: Applies Regeneration to practitioners in range; with Spiritus Ruina present, also drains nearby mobs to heal you.
ritual.neovitae.regeneration.info: Applies Regeneration to practitioners in range; with Spiritus Ruina present, also drains nearby mobs to heal you.
ritual.neovitae.shepherd.desc: Tends the animals in range: it hastens the growth of the young and coaxes ready adults into breeding, spending a little Essentia Vitae to feed them so no food or chest is required. Raw Spiritus quickens its pulse.
ritual.neovitae.shepherd.info: Tends the animals in range: it hastens the growth of the young and coaxes ready adults into breeding, spending a little Essentia Vitae to feed them so no food or chest is required. Raw Spiritus quickens its pulse.
ritual.neovitae.simple_dungeon: Breaching the Edge of Demon Realm
ritual.neovitae.simple_dungeon.desc: One-shot rite: consumes a large EV pool and assembles a complete Starter tier dungeon structure at the master ritual stone.
ritual.neovitae.simple_dungeon.info: One-shot rite: consumes a large EV pool and assembles a complete Starter tier dungeon structure at the master ritual stone.
ritual.neovitae.speed.desc: Propels non-sneaking entities in the master stone's facing direction. Sneak inside the area to receive Speed II for 30 minutes instead. Aspects modulate velocity, target filtering, and add Soft Fall.
ritual.neovitae.speed.info: Propels non-sneaking entities in the master stone's facing direction. Sneak inside the area to receive Speed II for 30 minutes instead. Aspects modulate velocity, target filtering, and add Soft Fall.
ritual.neovitae.sphere.desc: Scoops the ellipsoidal volume of terrain below the master stone and lifts it upward into a floating moon. Foundation block beneath the master sets the size: iron 41, gold 49, diamond 57, netherite 65 across, anything else 33. 10 EV per block moved; ~100 checks per refresh.
ritual.neovitae.sphere.info: Scoops the ellipsoidal volume of terrain below the master stone and lifts it upward into a floating moon. Foundation block beneath the master sets the size: iron 41, gold 49, diamond 57, netherite 65 across, anything else 33. 10 EV per block moved; ~100 checks per refresh.
ritual.neovitae.standard_dungeon.desc: Opens a permanent gateway to the Endless tier dungeon: a vast procedural dungeon (Mines, Foreman fight, aspected loot) that goes on forever and can be returned to as often as you like. Consumes a very large EV pool.
ritual.neovitae.standard_dungeon.info: Opens a permanent gateway to the Endless tier dungeon: a vast procedural dungeon (Mines, Foreman fight, aspected loot) that goes on forever and can be returned to as often as you like. Consumes a very large EV pool.
ritual.neovitae.structure.invalid: Ritual structure is incomplete or invalid.
ritual.neovitae.suppression.desc: Replaces fluid source blocks in range with air, restoring them when the ritual stops.
ritual.neovitae.suppression.info: Replaces fluid source blocks in range with air, restoring them when the ritual stops.
ritual.neovitae.torment_nexus.desc: Binds every spawner and trial spawner in range, suppressing their natural spawns and harvesting an equivalent stream of EV from the simulated kills. Loot funnels into a chest atop the master stone; an Experience Tome in the chest soaks up the kills' XP. Requires an Awakened Activation Crystal.
ritual.neovitae.torment_nexus.info: Binds every spawner and trial spawner in range, suppressing their natural spawns and harvesting an equivalent stream of EV from the simulated kills. Loot funnels into a chest atop the master stone; an Experience Tome in the chest soaks up the kills' XP. Requires an Awakened Activation Crystal.
ritual.neovitae.upgrade_remove.desc: Wipes every upgrade from worn Sentient Armor and resets used points to zero; no tomes are produced.
ritual.neovitae.upgrade_remove.info: Wipes every upgrade from worn Sentient Armor and resets used points to zero; no tomes are produced.
ritual.neovitae.water.desc: Places water source blocks in the area; with Raw Spiritus, also fills any fluid tank above the master stone (1 Raw per 1,000 mB).
ritual.neovitae.water.info: Places water source blocks in the area; with Raw Spiritus, also fills any fluid tank above the master stone (1 Raw per 1,000 mB).
ritual.neovitae.well_of_suffering.desc: Damages every hostile creature in range and channels their pain into Essentia Vitae at the master stone.
ritual.neovitae.well_of_suffering.info: Damages every hostile creature in range and channels their pain into Essentia Vitae at the master stone.
ritual.neovitae.yawning_void.desc: Erases blocks in a small box directly beneath the master ritual stone, one block per refresh. No drops. Spiritus Invictus moves the block to a placement volume above instead of consuming it; Spiritus Ruina limits consumption to blocks matching items in the chest above; Raw Spiritus accelerates the refresh rate.
ritual.neovitae.yawning_void.info: Erases blocks in a small box directly beneath the master ritual stone, one block per refresh. No drops. Spiritus Invictus moves the block to a placement volume above instead of consuming it; Spiritus Ruina limits consumption to blocks matching items in the chest above; Raw Spiritus accelerates the refresh rate.
ritual.neovitae.yawning_void.spiritus.in: Spiritus Invictus: Moves the cleared block into a 3x3x3 placement volume above the master stone instead of erasing it.
ritual.neovitae.yawning_void.spiritus.ra: Raw Spiritus: Accelerates the refresh rate; with enough raw aura, approaches one block per tick.
ritual.neovitae.yawning_void.spiritus.ru: Spiritus Ruina: Only consumes blocks whose item form matches the whitelist chest directly above the master stone.
ritual.neovitae.zephyr.desc: Persistent wind that gathers loose items and XP, depositing them with the master stone or a nearby player.
ritual.neovitae.zephyr.info: Persistent wind that gathers loose items and XP, depositing them with the master stone or a nearby player.
